note: acte de fiducie des obligations à 9,000 % 2031 (pièce 4.1 du 8-K de CoreWeave du 28 juillet 2025), panier (25) : garanties par CoreWeave de la dette de filiales liée au contrat OpenAI, plafonnées à 7,0 Md$, sous les mêmes ratios selon la notation d'OpenAI OpCo LLC ; autorisation, aucune garantie chiffrée ; autres paniers (coentreprises, option de vente de la série C) sans laboratoire
quote: (25) Indebtedness constituting a Guarantee of Indebtedness of any Subsidiary of the Company (including any Existing SPV or Future SPV) incurred in respect of the OpenAI Contract and any Refinancing Indebtedness in respect thereof, provided that (i) at the time such Guarantee is incurred, such Indebtedness being Guaranteed shall have (A) an LTV Ratio of no greater than 75.0%, if OpenAI OpCo LLC (or its Parent Entity or a Subsidiary thereof) does not have an Investment Grade Rating or (B) an LTV Ratio of no greater than 90.0%, if OpenAI OpCo LLC (or its Parent Entity or a Subsidiary thereof) has an Investment Grade Rating, or (C) an LTC Ratio of no greater than 100.0%, if the Indebtedness being Guaranteed consists solely of Equipment Indebtedness, and (ii) the aggregate principal amount of all Indebtedness constituting Guarantee under this clause (25) shall not exceed $7.0 billion; and
